name: Unending Torment

angles.text: For the Forsaken, the head shows how repeated repairs weaken an undead construct. It is a grim reminder of their queen's absolute authority and the Royal Apothecary Society's macabre ingenuity.
Horde adventurers who see the head glimpse the Forsaken's practice of repeated reanimation and flesh-crafting. These methods work, but they can unnerve peers who are more bound to honor.

faq.answer: The Abominable Head is the severed head of a unique construct, loosened when the creature is defeated. Its neck bears the scars of repeated reattachment, and each repair weakened the flesh and stitches. You bring it to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity for examination.

aliases: why was the head sewn back on
faq.answer: The head was stitched back after each fall or loss so the construct could be pieced together to continue serving or suffering. Its increasingly fragile neck eventually gave way again.
faq.q: Why has the head been reattached so many times?

faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society in the Apothecarium of the Undercity. Under Queen Sylvanas Windrunner's authority, he oversees Forsaken apothecaries researching poisons, plagues, and anatomical alterations. His familiarity with the Dark Lady's projects lets him identify the stitched head's origins at once.

The cruelty lies in the endless cycle itself. Each time the creature falls, it is sloppily stitched back together to serve or suffer once more, and each repair leaves it weaker. This is how the Dark Lady punishes her enemies. Faranell does not say who the creature once was, or what it did to earn this.
faq.q: Why does Sylvanas consider this a cruel joke?

aliases: what will the apothecaries do with it
faq.answer: Faranell regularly repurposes necromantic remnants, flesh, and biological oddities to develop concoctions, plagues, and construct reinforcements for the Forsaken's ongoing conflicts. He accepts the head for the society's alchemical and necromantic work.
faq.q: What will Faranell do with the head?

aliases: where to turn in unending torment
faq.answer: Bring the Abominable Head to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Apothecarium, in the Undercity's southern quadrant. He is surrounded by bubbling vats, assistants, and test subjects as he oversees the society's research.
faq.q: Where do you turn in the quest Unending Torment?

faq.answer: The delivery brings you to Master Apothecary Faranell inside the Apothecarium of the Undercity, so it is intended for Horde adventurers. Alliance adventurers who approach him would face hostile Undercity guards and death at the hands of the Forsaken upon entering their stronghold.
faq.q: Can Alliance players turn in this quest?

sections.body:
When the towering abomination falls in battle, its head topples from its shoulders. The neck was severed, stitched, torn away, and reattached many times. Each repair left the seam more fragile, until the head barely clung to its shoulders.

Such persistent patchwork is unusual even for undead constructs. The repeated destruction and reassembly suggest this abomination was rebuilt again and again. Ordinary scavengers could not explain its craftsmanship. Only the skilled flesh-crafters of the Undercity could identify the creature's origins.
sections.title: A Loose Stitch

sections.body:
At the Apothecarium, Master Apothecary Faranell, leader of the Royal Apothecary Society, recognizes the severed head at once. He sees its repeated reassembly as an intentional, cruel joke devised by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, not an accident of necromancy.

Only the Dark Lady and her inner circle know what offense earned the creature this degrading punishment. Faranell gleefully accepts the battered head, confident the Royal Apothecary Society can put it to use in their ongoing alchemical and necromantic endeavors.
sections.title: The Dark Lady's Jest

summary: The head of a fallen abomination sets Unending Torment in motion. Its repeated stitching points toward deliberate dark experimentation in the Forsaken capital, and you bring it to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
